title: AI-Enhanced Deliberative Democracy and the Future of the Collective Will

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure bias itself; rather, it conducts a theoretical review and proposes a future research agenda using qualitative expert reviews and quantitative embedding analyses to evaluate the propagation of left-leaning political biases and ideological cues in AI-generated democratic syntheses.

Conceptual discussion and literature review highlighting the risks of large language models reproducing and amplifying societal and racial stereotypes from their training data when summarizing open-ended reflective thoughts from the public.
